It started after my car wreck last December when I broke both my wrists. The symptoms have gotten worse over the last month, and I've also been having some mild stiffness in my neck.

Have you noticed any associated pain, weakness, or changes in sensation in your arms or fingers? Additionally, could you provide more details about the neck stiffness, such as its duration, severity, and whether it is associated with any headaches, dizziness, or visual changes?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The numbness and tingling started after my car wreck last December when I broke both wrists. At first, I thought it was just part of the healing process, but once my wrists healed, the tingling and numbness became more noticeable. They’ve gotten worse over the last month. I also have some mild stiffness in my neck, which I hit during the accident, and they told me it was a contusion. The stiffness isn’t too bad, but it’s been there since the accident. I haven’t had any headaches, dizziness, or visual changes with it.
